emission_definition: q is the unboosted video probability when raw frame p is in [0.2,0.8), otherwise raw frame p; no new inference

native_gate.serialization: float(f'{p:.6f}'), the R36/native Python formatting rule
native_gate.on_mismatch: STOP; do not run R49/R50 or adjust protocol

V2.raw_history: last freshly verified unboosted q, held between TRP calls; history appends this raw stream, while TCP base input and last-final TRP cache remain native

LOSO.held_out_unit: whole video sequence, all its expressions and objects
LOSO.calibration: intercept-only logistic calibration: sigmoid(logit(q)+bias); minimize training-only object-frame BCE with scipy bounded scalar minimization, bounds [-8,8], xatol=1e-8
LOSO.selection_objective: pooled semantic micro-F1 on the three training sequences only, after fitting bias for V4
LOSO.tie_break: maximum F1, then smaller p_stay, then threshold closest to 0.5, then smaller threshold
LOSO.new_ID_prior: empirical object-frame positive rate of the three training sequences; a user-prescribed statistic, not an additional tunable scalar
LOSO.fixed_version_prior: same training-only positive-rate prior for each held-out sequence, with all hyperparameters fixed
LOSO.HMM: causal two-state forward filter on every visible candidate frame; symmetric stay probability; across a gap of g image frames prior=0.5+(last_posterior-0.5)*(2*p_stay-1)^g; new ID starts at training prior; emission likelihoods are q_cal and 1-q_cal
LOSO.evaluation: pool all four held-out predictions, then official TrackEval HOTA.combine_sequences; never tune on the pooled validation results
LOSO.HMM_output: retain continuous posterior separately; write 0/1 decisions at its registered/fitted posterior threshold to official predictions, evaluated with unchanged --thresholds 0.6
LOSO.negative_retention_r: unknown; no prior correction inferred from a training-code default

R49.events: all F-class gap=1 true-to-false GT switches; event frame is the first false frame, 1-based MOT time
R49.visibility: only actual visible GT candidate rows; no interpolation across invisibility; windows can overlap and are event-weighted
curves: R22 p_video conditional on original routing, with coverage counts
native TCP Delta1 replay final score
R49.latency: first observed score below 0.6 at offsets 0..15; unseen/missing follow-up is censored, not treated as rejection; report observed crossing distribution and restricted/censored counts separately
R49.paired_latency: final-first-crossing minus raw-frame-first-crossing only for events with both observed; also report events still final-positive through last visible follow-up after raw drops
R49.latch: from first raw-frame p<0.6 until first final score<0.6, capped at offset15; count visible rows only, including raw rebounds; report fraction raw p in [0.1,0.6), plus fraction routed q<0.6
R49.delta1: official TCP unchanged, all-frame R22 cache, no TRP skipping
R49.interpretation: separate video changes from TCP using routed q and R50 V1/V2 controls; do not impute uncached video probabilities

metrics.HOTA: unmodified official TrackEval, min-area20, offset0, all objects mapped to pedestrian as before, integer output boxes
metrics.semantic: micro P/R/F1 over all GT candidate object-frames, gamma0.6 except HMM registered posterior decisions
metrics.empty_frame_false_alarm_rate: expression-image-frame with empty released GT and any predicted matching candidate / all empty released-GT expression-image-frames, including frames without any candidate
metrics.post_switch_error: event-weighted visible rows at F gap1 true-to-false offsets0..5, error vs actual current GT, including subsequent switches if any
metrics.category_delta_HOTA: A-H subset HOTA(variant)-subset HOTA(V0), using native sequence recombination; multi-label classes overlap; G=0 is N/A

R51.trigger: best fixed or out-of-fold LOSO variant has HOTA gain >=2 over V0
R51.on_trigger: CPU-only estimate for all-frame/frame-video TempRMOT* cache using R22 throughput; require explicit new user approval before any GPU launch
R51.otherwise: write conclusion; do not run GPU stage
